data.name: v6.2.0
data.body:
### Security
- Addresses CVE-2026-121885, untrusted image labels could be used to trick podman auto-update into restarting incorrect systemd units [GHSA-55rm-rwr7-q2wr](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/security/advisories/GHSA-55rm-rwr7-q2wr).
- Addresses CVE-2026-111361, malicious containers images could be able to bypass Digest and Signature validation [GHSA-pggw-qqjf-6cxw](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/security/advisories/GHSA-pggw-qqjf-6cxw).
- Addresses CVE-2026-123876, default seccomp profile socket deny rule could be bypass by a malicious container.

### Features
- The `podman push` command now supports a new option, `--platform`, which selects and pushes a single platform-specific manifest instead of the entire list.
- The `podman kube play` command now supports a new option, `--validate`, which determines how unrecognized YAML fields are handled ([#18332](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/18332)).
- The `podman kube play` command now supports a new option, `--label`, to set labels on created containers, pods, volumes, and secrets ([#26450](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/26450)).
- The `podman kube play` command can now create multiple pods if more than 1 replica is requested by a deployment using the new `--multiple-pods` option ([#26769](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/26769)).
- The `podman kube play --build` command now supports building images from subdirectories of the main context directory ([#28148](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28418)).
- Quadlet `.container` files now support a new key, `Umask`, to set the default umask for the created container ([#25278](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25278)).
- All Quadlet files now support a new key, `SetMountsDependency`, configuring whether the generated unit will use `RequiresMountsFor`, `WantsMountsFor`, or no dependency at all on required source paths ([#29946](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29946)).
- The `podman farm list` command now supports two new options, `--quiet`, which will print only the names of active farms, and `--noheading`, which omits column headers from the output.
- The `podman artifact ls` command now supports two new options, `--format=json`, which will output machine-readable JSON, and `--quiet`, which prints only artifact digests.
- The `podman create` command now supports a new option, `--passwd`, to add entries to `/etc/passwd` in the container (this has previously been available with `podman run`).
- The `podman info` command now includes detailed information on the features supported by OCI runtimes.
- The `podman events --filter` command now supports a new filter, `network=`, to filter to events pertaining to a specific network ([#29387](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29387)).
- The `podman auto-update` command has been enabled on the remote Podman client.
- The `StartInterval` field in image healthcheck configuration is now respected, allowing images to configure startup healthchecks ([#27724](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27724)).
- The `podman image scp` command now supports two new options, `--compression-format` and `--compression-level`, to compress data during transfer ([#23192](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/23192)).
- The `podman auto-update` command now supports a new option, `--filter`, to selectively update only containers that match the given filters.
- The `podman ps --sort` command now allows sorting by pod.
- The `podman ps --filter` command now supports a new filter, `status!`, which matches containers not in the given state ([#21398](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/21398)).

### Changes
- Podman now requires Go v1.26 or higher to build.
- The Podman machine WSL provider now has native systemd support, existing machines continue to be supported for now with our old custom systemd setup. We require at least WSL version 2.5.1 now, although we recommend using at least 2.7.5 for proper nftables networking support.
- The `podman kube play` command now uses the `securityContext.seccompProfile` fields in Kubernetes YAML for Seccomp configuration. Support for the existing annotation-based configuration of Seccomp is now deprecated, and will be removed with Podman 7.0.
- The `podman inspect` command on containers now includes three new fields, `DNSNames` (containing all names the container can be accessed via), `IsInitCtr` (whether the container is an init container), and `InitContainerType` (what type of init container this is, if it is one) ([#29811](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29811)).
- The `podman inspect` command on containers now only includes user-added DNS aliases in the `Aliases` field, which previously displayed all DNS aliases, improving Docker compatibility.
- The `podman inspect` command on containers now properly populates the `ConsoleSize` field for running containers ([#28368](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28368)).
- Systemd units created by Podman healthchecks are now named much more clearly (`libpod-healthcheck-$CONTAINERID-$randsuffix.service`) ([#29373](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29373)).
- Signal proxying is now enabled for attached `podman exec` commands. As such, killing a `podman exec` command with Control-C or similar should now also kill the processes started in the container (similar to how `podman run` already works) ([#19486](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/19486)).
- The deprecated `--cpu-rt-period` and `--cpu-rt-runtime` options for `podman create`, `podman run`, `podman update`, and `podman container clone` are now hidden and undocumented. They have not been functional since the removal of cgroups v1 support and will be removed entirely in Podman v7.
- The `--health-startup-interval` option to `podman create`, `podman run`, and `podman update` has a new alias, `--health-start-interval`.
- When a startup healthcheck interval is specified, but no startup healthcheck command, the standard healthcheck command will be used instead.
- When using the `journald` event driver, timestamps are no longer included in logged events, as `journald` includes a timestamp already ([#29835](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29835)).
- Quadlet can now create template instances from instance-specific drop-in directories without requiring an explicit instance file or symlink ([#27636](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27636)).

### Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug where passing an empty file to the `--ignorefile` option to `podman build` would cause the `.dockerignore` or `.containerignore` file in the context directory to be used, instead of not using an ignorefile at all ([#25147](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25147)).
- Fixed a bug where the `Pod=` key in Quadlet `.container` files did not expand the `%N` specifier ([#29108](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29108)).
- Fixed a bug where containers created with `--userns=auto` would report having a `private` user namespace in `podman inspect` after they started, but not when they were first created.
- Fixed a bug where logging was configured too late in the Podman init process to print errors from parsing configuration files ([#25362](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25362)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman system prune --build` command could fail if a build container was removed while it was running.
- Fixed a bug where `copy` events from `podman machine cp` were not properly displayed by the remote Podman client.
- Fixed a bug where the `podman farm build --tag` command would fail if given a tag including a colon ([#25039](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25039)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine init --image` command would fail when given a read-only disk image.
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine start` and `podman machine init --now` commands could hang on Windows systems using the Hyper-V provider if the VM failed to start ([#29455](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29455)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine start` command on Windows (both Hyper-V and WSL providers) would sometimes fail due to leftover processes from previous machines ([#29474](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29474)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine start` command could hang indefinitely if the VM failed to start properly ([#29880](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29880)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine start` command could create a VM that cannot be connected to on Windows if the host was shut down or restarted when the VM was running ([#29971](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29971)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine init` command on Windows when using the Hyper-V provider did not correctly detach the file server process, causing VMs to lose access to host shares when the console that ran `podman machine init` closed ([#29573](http://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29573)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman kube play` command incorrectly handled `emptyDir` volumes with `medium: Memory`, causing them to not be shared between containers in the pod and to ignore the `sizeLimit` parameter ([#29555](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29555)).
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client's `podman kube play` command incorrectly handled authentication credentials in API requests.
- Fixed a bug where volumes created by the `podman volume import` command would not adjust their permissions on being mounted into a container ([#25442](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25442)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman build` command could leak temporary directories if a build failed ([#22642](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/22642)).
- Fixed a bug where containers created with `--userns=keep-id` would use an image-specified user instead of forcing the same UID/GID in use on the host ([#29600](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29600)).
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client could not function when connecting over SSH to a server which does not support the direct-streamlocal channel type ([#27814](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27814)).
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client's `podman push`, `podman artifact push`, and `podman manifest push` commands would push an unsigned image instead of failing when the `--sign-by` or `--sign-by-sigstore-private-key` options were used.
- Fixed a bug where creating a container with `--userns=auto` that had overlay volume mounts would fail ([#28758](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28758)).
- Fixed a bug where volume subpaths including a `=` character in the path were handled incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client was unable to add subjects to artifacts with the `podman manifest annotate --subject` and `podman manifest add --artifact subject` commands.
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client's `podman manifest add --artifact` command could hang under some circumstances.
- Fixed a bug where the `podman manifest annotate --os-features` command did not properly save the OS features in the manifest.
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client's `podman image prune --filter` did not correctly handle filters with values including the `=` character.
- Fixed a bug where Quadlet `.volume` units did not recreate the volume if it was removed in Podman ([#27862](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27862)).
- Fixed a bug where containers with a failing startup healthcheck would not immediately transition to unhealthy when the startup period ended.
- Fixed a bug where containers started with `--sdnotify=healthy` and a `HealthStartPeriod` longer than the unit's `TimeoutStartSec` could be automatically killed by systemd if the healthcheck took an extended period to become healthy ([#27290](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27290)).
- Fixed a bug where the `--pids-limit=0` argument to `podman run` and `podman create` was incorrectly setting a process limit, instead of removing the limit, when the `runc` OCI runtime was in use ([#29826](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29826)).
- Fixed a bug where Quadlet did not search the parent directory of symlinked unit files for drop-in configuration files, which broke using Quadlets defined by root as a rootless user if drop-in overrides were in use ([#29821](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29821)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman ps` and `podman pod ps` commands would fail when the `--format` argument was used with a format string including `.Label` ([#29831](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29831)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman cp` command did not respect volume subpaths when copying into a mounted named or image volumes in a container that is not running ([#29840](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29840) and [#29857](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29857)).
- Fixed a bug where volume plugins were initialized when they were not required, which could cause early-boot containers started by Quadlet to error on missing plugins that the container was not actually using ([#28110](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28110)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman export` command, when run by a rootless user on a container created with `--userns=keep-id`, would create an archive with incorrect UIDs and GIDs ([#29856](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29856)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman system service` command would fail to start when run as a systemd unit and autostarted at the same time as other Podman units ([#29964](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29964)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman events` command would return incomplete output when using the `file` events backend and `--until` specified with a time in the past ([#29579](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29579)).
- Fixed a bug where the `podman update` command allowed setting a startup healthcheck on a container without a normal healthcheck.
- Fixed a bug where the remote Podman client's `podman secret rm` command would fail when given an ambiguous name that could match multiple possible secrets.
- Fixed a bug where the `podman machine info` command would report the default VM type and config/image directories, not those used by the current machine.
- Fixed a bug where the `podman inspect` command on containers did not include `CheckpointLog` after a failed container checkpoint ([#25154](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25154)).

### API
- The Libpod API now features a new endpoint, `POST /libpod/autoupdate`, which automatically updates containers with the `io.containers.autoupdate` label.
- The Compat API now features a new endpoint, `GET /distribution/{name}/json`, which inspects an image on a registry ([#17726](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/17726)).
- The Compat Create endpoint for Containers now supports a new field, `HostConfig.Mounts.TmpfsOptions.Options`, to set additional options for tmpfs mounts.
- The Compat Create endpoint for Containers now allows a full Seccomp profile to be passed in the `HostConfig.SecurityOpt` field (instead of a path to a file containing a profile), improving Docker compatibility ([#27710](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27710)).
- The Compat Push endpoint for Images now supports a new query parameter, `platform`, to push only a single platform-specific manifest instead of the entire list.
- The Compat Info endpoint now includes the status of active OCI runtimes.
- Fixed a bug where the Libpod Create endpoint for Containers required that the `auto` userns mode also specify full UID/GID mappings for the created container.
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Create endpoint for Containers would incorrectly adjust mode when setting tmpfs size.
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Create endpoint for Containers would incorrectly treat a healthcheck of `{}` as the user explicitly requesting no healthcheck, instead of using the image's healthcheck as Docker does ([#29467](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29467)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Inspect endpoint for Secrets allowed the `showsecret` query parameter, which should be restricted to Libpod API requests only ([#29570](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29570)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Inspect endpoint for Images included the `Created` field even when it was empty.
- Fixed a bug where the Compat List and Inspect endpoints for Networks did not include `IPRange` in the returned `IPAMConfig` ([#28378](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28378)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat List endpoint for Containers would error when passed a filter including container statuses supported by Docker but not Podman (`dead` and `restarting`) ([#28904](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28904)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Stats endpoint for Containers could panic on containers with a memory reservation, but no memory limit, set ([#29627](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29627)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Stats endpoint for Containers incorrectly populated `system_cpu_usage` and `percpu_stats` when not streaming ([#28761](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28761), [#24730](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/24730), [#25709](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25709), [#29912](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29912)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat Info endpoint reported an incorrect cgroup manager when running rootless with the `cgroupfs` cgroup manager ([#27824](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27824)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat and Libpod Attach endpoints for Containers would, when doing a logs-only (`stream=0` and `logs=1`) attach, incorrectly reinitialize the container, changing its exit code and status ([#29664](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29664
)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat and Libpod Update endpoints would incorrectly clear a container's restart policy when it was omitted from the request ([#29790](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29790)).
- Fixed a bug where the Compat and Libpod Start endpoints for Exec sessions would return an error when trying to start an exec session with no standard streams attached without specifying `Detach=true`.
- Fixed a bug where the Libpod Generate Kube endpoint returned the wrong content type ([#29674](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29674)).
- Numerous fixes to the API's Swagger documentation have been made to ensure it accurately documents the REST API.

### Misc
- Fixed a number of low-level resource leaks in various parts of Podman.
- Waiting for `gvproxy` to start when starting a `podman machine` VM now uses a notification socket, instead of polling, improving reliability and startup time.
- Updated documentation for the `--image-volume` option to `podman create` and `podman run` to remove the deprecated `bind` option and add the new default, `anonymous`, which was not shown as a valid option. Using the deprecated `bind` option now prints a warning.
- Updated Buildah to v1.46.0
- Updated Common to v0.70.0
- Updated Image to v5.42.1
- Updated Storage to v1.64.2

data.name: v1.22.3
data.body:
This is a bugfix release for a type checker regression in v1.22.0.

It also includes a dependency bump for github.com/klauspost/compress.

> [!NOTE]
> The [security advisory in question is GHSA-fpmh-frq8-7rj8](https://github.com/klauspost/compress/security/advisories/GHSA-fpmh-frq8-7rj8).
> Note that OPA does not support `zstd` compression in its handlers, but automated vulnerability checkers still flag this as an issue, which is why we bump this version in a patch release.

### Allow keys of empty collections in rules replaced by `with`

A rule like `default x := {}` is typed as an empty collection, so any constant key on it is rejected, even though tests replace it using `with`. Empty collections in the types of rules that a with modifier targets are now typed as any.

### Dependency Updates

  - build(deps): Bump github.com/agnivade/levenshtein from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2

## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features 🎉
* Update artifact_accessory to add source column to identify accessory by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23144
* feat: replace redis with valkey as cache backend by @chlins in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23157
* Full Multi-Architecture Enablement for Harbor (amd64 + arm64) by @ranimandepudi in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/22311
* Add ListReferrers API to registry client and update parseScopes by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23170
* Proxy the referrer API to upstream registry with paging and local merge by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23237
* feat(ui): support advanced proxy cache configurations in UI by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23536
* feat(backend): implement proxy cache repository filter API by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23527
* Custom project roles — frontend UI by @maxgraustenzel-create in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23970
* feat(task): aggregate execution error messages and surface task failure details by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/24028
### Enhancement 🚀
* Fix Last Pull time on parent/child artifacts and on creation by @BojanZelic in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/22402
* fix(proxy): preserve URL path prefix during registry auth discovery by @mco69 in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/22989
* Add UI option to enable proxy cache referrer API by @stonezdj in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23151
* ci: add API schema drift check for v2.0 swagger spec by @infracore in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23089
* refactor(task): use Redis SET with SPOP for outdate execution status … by @chlins in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23183
* test(cosign): disable tlog for signing checks by @chlins in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23279
* perf(replication): filter event policies in query by @chlins in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23283
* fix: enable chunked blob upload for Azure ACR replication by @xrkolovos in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23016
* feat(audit): add member create/update/delete audit events by @Mauraza in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23228
* fix: add registry component to proxy configuration support by @Kibakus in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23437
* fix: set MaxIdleConnsPerHost on internal HTTP transports by @chlins in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23591
* Add proxy cache hit/miss metrics by @Jason-Lee3 in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23578
* fix: implement signature inheritance for OCI index children by @Aloui-Ikram in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/23540
* fix(api): return 404 when listing artifacts of a non-existing repository by @tpoxa in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/17618
### Component updates ⬆️
* fix the git action publish permission issue by @wy65701436 in https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/pull/22840

data.name: v1.37.0
data.body:
See the full [kOps 1.37 release notes](https://kops.sigs.k8s.io/releases/1.37-notes/) for details, including breaking changes and deprecations.

## Highlights

* **Kubernetes 1.37 support**, with etcd 3.7.3 as the default for Kubernetes 1.37 clusters
* **Private asset repositories in cloud object storage**: `s3://`, `gs://`, and `azureblob://` URLs for `KOPS_BASE_URL` and `spec.assets.fileRepository`, with nodes authenticating through their instance identity
* **Smaller and more resilient node bootstrap**: the nodeup download drops from about 120 MB to under 10 MB, through a smaller binary and xz compression, and bootstrap retries failed tasks
* **Container runtime**: containerd 2.3.6 and runc 1.5.1 by default, with containerd configuration version 4; containerd versions older than 2.1.0 are no longer supported
* **Karpenter expansion**: Karpenter v1.15.1, kOps-managed interruption handling (SQS queue and EventBridge rules), root volume settings in `EC2NodeClass`, `instanceRequirements` support, and mixed GPU and non-GPU instance groups
* **Narrower AWS IAM permissions** for the instance roles (Route 53, KMS, EC2, SQS), and no inline policies for roles that need no permissions
* **etcd-manager changes**: bundled etcd images mounted as image volumes, and support for custom etcd versions from a user-supplied image on new clusters
* **Networking**: Calico v3.32.3 with the move to `ClusterNetworkPolicy`, network policy support for AWS VPC CNI, kube-router v2.12.0 with an experimental nftables network policy backend, and kindnet v1.0.3
* **Azure**: bootstrap requests authenticated with signed instance metadata, `kops rolling-update cluster` detection of outdated VMs, and two cloud-controller-manager replicas on highly available control planes
* **Akamai (Linode)**: the experimental provider now manages SSH keys, networks, subnets, instances, and block-storage volumes
* **Component updates**: etcd-manager v3.0.20261022 with etcd 3.5.35/3.6.16/3.7.3, Cilium v1.18.16, AWS VPC CNI v1.23.2, CoreDNS v1.15.0, AWS Load Balancer Controller v3.6.2, cert-manager v1.21.3, cluster-autoscaler v1.37.0
* **Removed**: support for Kubernetes 1.31, gossip DNS (and `protokube`), AWS Classic Load Balancers for the API, and Kopeio networking. Migrate with kOps 1.36 before the upgrade

## What's Changed
* Support etcd 3.7.0-rc.0 and allow overriding the etcd version in the scalability scenario by @Jefftree in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18458
* Enable misspell in golangci-lint by @ameukam in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/17578
* e2e: Filter random AZ selection by instance type availability by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18463
* azure: Use IMDS attested metadata document for node identity by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18163
* gce: fix backend service ownership filtering during delete by @carterpewpew in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18460
* aws: Reconcile target group health check changes on existing target groups by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18467
* gce: Reconcile HTTP health check changes on existing health checks by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18468
* Improve Google Storage Bucket support. by @cheftako in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18466
* Enable gosec and gocritic by @ameukam in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18470
* Add serathius as scalability test owner by @Jefftree in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18475
* feat(linode): implement SSH key management and associated tasks by @moshevayner in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18383
* Added support for APIServer using LB by @cheftako in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18459
* chore(channels): bump k8s versions in alpha channel by @moshevayner in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18477
* Upgrade Karpenter to v1.13.0  by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18479
* scaletest: Report experiment variant into scalability run metadata by @Jefftree in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18476
* channels: Add Kubernetes 1.36.0 support by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18480
* gce: emit kops.k8s.io/instancegroup node label by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18484
* e2e: Skip ImageVolume tests on COS 121 by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18483
* Register Karpenter nodes with karpenter.sh/unregistered taint by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18486
* Add missing EC2 read permissions to Karpenter IAM policy by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18487
* scaletest: report experiment variant after kubetest2 runs by @Jefftree in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18485
* nodeup: load ip_set module and disable firewalld on RHEL10 by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18478
* API only CLI by @cheftako in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18482
* Fixing LB behavior when you have both APIServer and Control Plane. by @cheftako in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18496
* Remove namespace from DO ClusterRole by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18498
* chore(channels): promote to stable, bump node images, update recommended kOps versions by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18501
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6.0.3 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18505
* scaletest: bind etcd metrics to all interfaces by @Jefftree in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18503
* e2e: test the PR's own channels, not master's by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18504
* tests/e2e: refine externalTrafficPolicy=Local and hostNetwork skips by @rifelpet in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18509
* Allow setting missing slice elements from the command line by @hakman in https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18511

data.name: Istio 1.32.0
data.body: [Release Notes](https://istio.io/latest/news/releases/1.32.x/announcing-1.32/)

* [CHANGE] Promote the `auto-gomemlimit` feature flag to the `--auto-gomemlimit` command-line flag. This is a breaking change: the `--enable-feature=auto-gomemlimit` option has been removed. #5464
* [CHANGE] Remove the deprecated `types` package in favor of the `alert` package. #5585
* [CHANGE] eventrecorder: Every output now requires a `name`. This is a breaking change: configurations with unnamed outputs fail to load. The name identifies the output in metrics and logs instead of its URL, broker or topic. #5393
* [CHANGE] eventrecorder: The output data format now uses the new `events/v2` schema. This is a breaking change: alert labels, alert annotations, group labels, silence annotations, and muted-alert labels are JSON maps, and protobuf consumers must use the new schema. #5409, #5500
* [FEATURE] Add a distroless container image. #5258
* [FEATURE] amtool: Look up the default config file in `%APPDATA%` and `%ProgramData%` on Windows. #5073
* [FEATURE] api: Add an experimental ConnectRPC API served alongside `/api/v2/` under the version-neutral `/api/` prefix, exposing the Connect, gRPC, and gRPC-Web protocols plus the gRPC Health Checking Protocol and server reflection. The first service is `status.v3.StatusService`. #5377, #5506, #5507, #5508, #5509
* [FEATURE] incidentio: Add templated `metadata` field. #5022
* [FEATURE] pagerduty: Report more specific failure reasons in `alertmanager_notifications_failed_total`. #5659
* [FEATURE] rocketchat: Add `message_text` option to set the message text shown in desktop and push notifications. #5595
* [FEATURE] slack: Add `post_updates_to_thread` option to post subsequent notifications of an alert group as replies in the thread of the initial message. #5540
* [FEATURE] telegram: Add `timeout` option to limit how long a notification request may take. #5127
* [FEATURE] telegram: Count only visible HTML text toward the message length limit, excluding link URLs. #5499
* [FEATURE] template: Add `addDuration` function to shift a timestamp by a duration such as `-30m` and return it in Unix milliseconds. #5550
* [FEATURE] template: Allow the `join` function to accept slices and arrays of any type. #5233
* [FEATURE] timeinterval: Allow weekday ranges to wrap around the end of the week, e.g. `friday:monday`. #5579
* [FEATURE] ui: Make the creator and comment of a silence optional, matching the API. #5471
* [FEATURE] ui: Serve the new Mantine UI at `/ui/` alongside the existing UI. #5502, #5538, #5539, #5537
* [ENHANCEMENT] Compute alert fingerprints once at ingestion instead of on every mute check, reducing CPU usage and allocations. #5583
* [ENHANCEMENT] api: Speed up `/api/v2/alerts/groups` by evaluating mutes only once per alert and group. #5674
* [ENHANCEMENT] cluster: Fix the `memeberlist` typo in error messages. #5472
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Add a Gotify example using a custom webhook payload. #5408, #5498
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Add a reusable HTML email template example. #5391
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Clarify the usage of the KV `Remove` template function. #5297
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Clarify which route options are inherited by child routes. #5565
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Correct the PagerDuty default config. #5397
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Document OAuth2 support in the `http_config` of `jira_config`. #5571
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Document VictorOps custom fields. #5399
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Document `project` and `issue_type` in `jira_config` as templated strings. #5549
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Document `victorops_api_key` and `victorops_api_key_file` in the global config. #5168
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Fix `rocketchat_config` defaults and field types. #5591
* [ENHANCEMENT] docs: Fix the `tracing` config key, which was misspelled as `traciing`. #5437
* [ENHANCEMENT] notify: Add the receiver name to the log message for failed notifications. #5401
* [ENHANCEMENT] silences: Reduce allocations when computing the `alertmanager_silences` metric. #5460
* [ENHANCEMENT] victorops: Use Splunk On-Call branding in documentation and error messages without renaming configuration fields. #5402
* [BUGFIX] api: Report alerts muted by time intervals as of the time of the request instead of the last group flush, matching silences and inhibitions. #5661
* [BUGFIX] cluster: Downgrade memberlist to v0.5.4 to fix `Failed to read remote state: user state length (...) exceeds limit` errors. #5640
* [BUGFIX] config: Fix merging of global configs for the smtp, opsgenie, victorops and rocketchat notifiers. #5448, #5457
* [BUGFIX] discord: Retry notifications on HTTP 429 (rate limited) instead of dropping them. #5496
* [BUGFIX] httpserver: Fix the `/-/reload` endpoint getting stuck when the client cancels the request. #5234
* [BUGFIX] notify: Wait the full backoff interval before retrying a notification that failed slowly. #5497, #5389, #5553
* [BUGFIX] opsgenie: Respect the notification timeout and tracing span for the update-message request sent when `update_alerts` is enabled. #5465
* [BUGFIX] pagerduty: Report the failure reason of Events API v1 requests in `alertmanager_notifications_failed_total` instead of `reason="other"`. #5505
* [BUGFIX] pushover: Trim whitespace from `token_file` and `user_key_file` contents so keys stored in files with a trailing newline are accepted. #5590
* [BUGFIX] silences: Treat a silence as expired at exactly its end time, consistent with the API. #5665
* [BUGFIX] silences: Use a single evaluation time for each read or write of silences. #5666
* [BUGFIX] slack: Avoid a panic when `update_message` relies on `global.slack_api_url`. #5589
* [BUGFIX] slack: Retry notifications on HTTP 429 (rate limited) and honor the `Retry-After` header instead of dropping them. #5048
* [BUGFIX] telegram: Redact the bot token from logged notification errors. #5254
* [BUGFIX] telegram: Report the failure reason in `alertmanager_notifications_failed_total`. #5375
* [BUGFIX] template: Preserve quoted numeric strings as strings in templated JSON fields. #5098
* [BUGFIX] timeinterval: Fix negative `days_of_month` resolving one day early in months with a DST transition. #5447
* [BUGFIX] timeinterval: Reject month numbers outside 1-12. #5626
* [BUGFIX] webex: Fix a panic when truncating long notifications containing non-ASCII characters. #5544
* [BUGFIX] webex: Retry notifications on HTTP 429 (rate limited) and honor the `Retry-After` header instead of dropping them. #5548
* [BUGFIX] wechat: Report template errors in `corp_id` and `api_secret` instead of sending a token request with empty values. #5688

data.name: v4.0.1
data.body:
## Improvements
**[Agent]** Enhanced Reactor tracing — propagate unsampled traces across publishOn, subscribeOn, delay, and interval (#14604)
**[Agent]** Propagate unsampled traces across Reactor subscribe and retry (#14594)
**[Agent]** Propagate unsampled traces across coroutine dispatch (#14592)
**[Agent]** Added user-supplied URI template support for URI stat in the Jetty plugins (#14546)
**[Agent]** Added serviceName to the span event ContextData
**[Collector]** Apply the durability setting to SpanChunk (#14544)
**[Web]** Added a search box to the sidebar service selector
**[Web]** Added a search box to the server map service selector
**[Web]** Switched the alarm modules from thymeleaf to thymeleaf-spring6 (#14534)

## Bug Fixes
**[Agent]** Fixed a class retransform issue by keeping the original constant pool indices when rewriting a class from its class file (#9246)
**[Agent]** Fixed a Base64 decoding compatibility issue by downgrading commons-codec to 1.22.1 (#14605)
**[Agent]** Fixed an unnecessary retransform by skipping Spring beans that declare no method to intercept
**[Agent]** Fixed the trace block depth in DisableTrace and DisableChildTrace traceBlockEnd()
**[Web]** Fixed the DEFAULT servicemap not applying the search option (#14600)
**[Web]** Fixed the server map right-click handlers to read the latest disableMenu state
**[Web]** Fixed the Apdex hover popup to attach to the side of the node that has room
**[Web]** Fixed the Apdex and service group popups disappearing when the server map menu is disabled
**[Web]** Fixed an extra drawer scroll when viewing servers
**[Web]** Fixed the group-by remove button showing when the error table cannot remove a group
**[Web]** Fixed focus to return to the service search box with ArrowUp from the first result

## Security
**[none]** Bumped fastjson from 1.2.83 to 1.2.84 to fix CVE-2026-16723 (RCE under the default configuration) (#14584)
**[Web]** Bumped handlebars, storybook, and shell-quote to fix critical vulnerabilities
**[Web]** Bumped vite, zod, and transitive dependencies to fix high vulnerabilities
**[Web]** Bumped postcss-selector-parser to 7.1.7 to fix a moderate vulnerability

data.name: v1.156.0
data.body:
## [v1.156.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.156.0)

Released at 2026-11-09

* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics [Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) components: run with the `-eula` command-line flag to accept [ESA](https://victoriametrics.com/legal/esa/). License keys are no longer verified. The `-license`, `-licenseFile`, `-licenseFile.reloadInterval` and `-license.forceOffline` flags are deprecated and are treated as `-eula`, so existing setups keep working. See [Running VictoriaMetrics Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#running-victoriametrics-enterprise).
* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add new metric `process_cgroup_cpu_throttled_seconds_total` which exposes CPU throttling. See [#10430](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10430).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): support `authentication_method: WorkloadIdentity` in [azure_sd_configs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#azure_sd_configs). It allows discovering Azure VMs from Kubernetes clusters with [workload identity federation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/workload-id/workload-identity-federation) without a static client secret. See [#11558](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11558). Thanks to @banlor for contribution.
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add a new flag `-remoteWrite.queuePath`, which allows configuring [persistent-queue](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#on-disk-persistence) path for each `-remoteWrite.url` independently. See [#11662](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11662).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add `vmagent_kafka_consumer_rebalance_events_total` and `vmagent_kafka_consumer_assigned_partitions` metrics for monitoring partition rebalancing and distribution. See [partition distribution](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/#partition-distribution) and [#11370](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11370).
* FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): add `-notifier.sanitizeLabelNames` command-line flag. Set it to `false` to send alert label names to notifiers without replacing characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_:]` with underscores. This is useful for Alertmanager v0.27.0 or newer, which [supports UTF-8 label names](https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#utf-8-strict-mode) when not running in classic mode. See [#11629](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11629).
* FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), `vmstorage` and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): expose the working-set cache mode via `vm_cache_mode` for `storage/tsid`, `storage/metricIDs`, `storage/metricName`, `indexdb/tagFiltersLoops`, and `promql/rollupResult` cache. Values are `0` for split, `1` for switching, and `2` for whole. This metric helps users understand the internal memory and cache mechanisms. See [#11860](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11860).

* BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: OS `solaris` fixes compilation error. See [#11850](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11850). Thanks to @szaydel for contribution.
* BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: correctly detect `CPU` and `memory` `cgroup` limits configured via [systemd slices](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.slice.html) in `cgroup v1`. Previously, only the global host cgroup limit was used, which could cause OOM errors and CPU throttling. See [#11827](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11827).
* BUGFIX: [alerts](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules): stop [vmbackupmanager alerting rules](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-vmbackupmanager.yml) `NoLatestBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoHourlyBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoDailyBackupWithinLast3Days`, `NoWeeklyBackupWithinLast14Days` and `NoMonthlyBackupWithinLast62Days` from firing when scheduled backups are disabled via `-disableScheduledBackups` or the corresponding backup type is disabled via `-disableHourly`, `-disableDaily`, `-disableWeekly` or `-disableMonthly`. See [#11543](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11543).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): properly delay flushes after a sudden ingestion lag spike when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled. Previously, a data gap or a restart could reduce the tolerance for delayed samples to the aggregation interval, resulting in more dropped samples than necessary. See [#11866](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11866).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent skipping aggregation and deduplication flushes when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled and incoming samples are delayed by one interval or more, e.g. when the ingestion pipeline is overloaded. Previously, the flush delay could grow with the sample lag, causing skipped flushes and gaps in the results. Now the flush delay is capped at 90% of the aggregation or deduplication interval. See [#11811](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11811).
* BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent spikes in `rate_sum` and `rate_avg` outputs with `enable_windows: true` when out-of-order samples arrive around the aggregation window boundary. Previously, an out-of-order sample could be treated as a counter reset, causing large spike in the result. See [#11810](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11810).
* BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): send staleness markers for recording rule series with their original labels when a label value contains `,` or `=`, and avoid reporting distinct label sets as duplicates when these symbols occur in label values. Previously, staleness markers could be sent with broken labels and distinct label sets could collide in the series key. See [#11851](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11851). Thanks to @sarankumar1325 for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly calculate [running_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#running_avg) and [range_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#range_avg) for series with `NaN` points in the middle. Previously, every `NaN` point was counted in the divisor, so each value after the gap moved the result by less than it should. See [#11823](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11823). Thanks to @spicysharkco for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): do not increase `vm_http_request_errors_total` when a query is cancelled. This prevents false `RequestErrorsToAPI` alerts from firing. See [#11828](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11828).
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly parse `metricsql` expression numbers with leading zeroes, such as `09` or `08`. See [#11621](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11621). Thanks to @andriibeee for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly check `-search.maxPointsSubqueryPerTimeseries` limit for [subqueries](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#subqueries). Previously it could cause runtime panic. See [#11862](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11862).
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): correctly cancel query request if `-search.skipSlowReplicas` flag is set. See [#11771](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11771) for details.
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): fixes predefined dashboard rows not expanding when clicking the row title. See [#11829](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11829). Thanks to @nikshrma for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): support label names with special characters in series aliases. See [#11822](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11822). Thanks to @kema-dev for contribution.

data.name: v2.8.8
data.body:
This patch release fixes PhysicalMachineChaos configuration, workflow deletion, controller selection, and TimeChaos on ARM64. It also fixes Dashboard HTTP task parsing, skips terminated pods by default, and includes build updates.

### Breaking changes

> [!WARNING]
> - **Redis Sentinel `redisPath`.** The previous boolean type was incorrect. Chaosd expects a directory string for the `redis-server` executable. This release corrects the field type to a string. Remove existing boolean values or replace them with a directory string before upgrading. [#5204](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5204)
> - **PhysicalMachineChaos disk-fill.** Chaos Mesh uses `fill-by-fallocate`, while Chaosd uses `fallocate`. This release correctly maps the Chaos Mesh field to the Chaosd field. Chaosd defaults to `fallocate`, but Chaos Mesh uses `fallocate` only when `fill-by-fallocate` is explicitly set to `true`. Setting it to `false` or omitting it now uses `dd`. The field names and default behavior may be unified in a future release. [#5205](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5205)

### Changed

- Use Go build metadata for binary version information and preserve release versions for builds from release tags [#5198](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5198)
- Remove CGO dependency from chaos-daemon-helper (cdh) [#4801](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4801)

### Fixed

- Fix PhysicalMachineChaos disk-fill requests to honor `fill-by-fallocate`. Setting it to `true` uses `fallocate`. Setting it to `false` or omitting it now uses `dd` [#5205](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5205)
- Fix PhysicalMachineChaos Redis Sentinel `redisPath` to accept executable directories. Remove existing boolean values before upgrading [#5204](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5204)
- Fix missing Kafka authentication, fill configuration, and IO broker settings in PhysicalMachineChaos, and keep Kafka credentials out of controller logs [#5203](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5203)
- Fix the Chaos Dashboard HTTP task parser panicking on a header without a colon and accepting a command without a URL [#5200](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5200)
- Fix workflow deletion getting stuck when reconcilers recreate dependent resources while their owner is terminating [#5101](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5101)
- Fix selective controller enablement through `controllerManager.enabledControllers` for chaos experiments [#4980](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4980)
- Skip Succeeded and Failed pods when `podPhaseSelectors` is unset [#5150](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5150)
- Honor reconciliation cancellation in PhysicalMachineChaos requests to chaosd. [#5095](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5095)
- Fix TimeChaos crashes on ARM64 and preserve injection errors. [#5179](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5179)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/compare/v2.8.7...v2.8.8

data.name: v1.21.2
data.body:
# Improvements
Rook v1.21.2 is a patch release limited in scope and focusing on feature additions and bug fixes to the Ceph operator.

- operator: Disable msgr1 on osd, mgr, and mds when msgr2 is required (#18557, @trukhinyuri)
- osd: Filter RBD devices from LVM scans on host-based OSDs (#18413, @pujitha24)
- osd: Don't wipe metadata devices of existing OSDs (#18686, @lbarrosby)
- object: Log only the rgw zone fields rook reads (#18662, @jhoblitt)
- core: Redact secret flag values from reported commands (#18665, @jhoblitt)
- cephfsmirror: Stop embedding the peer bootstrap token in an error (#18661, @jhoblitt)
- nfs: Include cluster config overrides in client config (#18627, @taaahaaa)
- osd: Redact the lockbox secret from lvm zap output (#18670, @jhoblitt)
- security: Drop radosgw-admin output from object store errors (#18669, @jhoblitt)
- object: Redact credentials in CephBucketTopic endpoint logs (#18671, @jhoblitt)
- object: Add VAULT_TRANSIT_BACKEND_PATH for the RGW SSE-S3 transit mount (#18598, @A-RYAN-1)
- build: Bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 from 4.1.4 to 4.1.6 (#18677, @jhoblitt)
- kms: Migrate IBM Key Protect client to v1.0.1 (#18488, @travisn)
- test: Summarize most Secrets in collected logs instead of dumping them (#18668, @jhoblitt)
- object: Refuse OBC relink of a bucket owned by another user (#18660, @jhoblitt)
- operator: Retry CephCluster status update on conflict (#18639, @taraasrita10)

- [CHANGE] API: The experimental search endpoints now clamp `batch_size` to 1000. #19731
- [CHANGE] Configuration: Default --web.external-url to https when --web.config.file enables TLS. #19241
- [CHANGE] PromQL: Subquery samples are now included in the query TotalSamples and TotalSamplesPerStep statistics, and SamplesRead now counts reads from subqueries with an @ modifier in range queries. #19165
- [CHANGE] Remote write: Stop exposing the deprecated `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_failed_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_retried_total`, and `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_bytes_total` metrics for Remote Write 2.0 queues. #20080
- [CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in `prometheus_api_remote_write_without_metadata_appended_samples_total` even when `metadata-wal-records` is disabled. #19812
- [CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from `/api/v1/query_exemplars`. #19896
- [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the `X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps` HTTP header. #19066
- [FEATURE] Agent: Support metadata-wal-records in Prometheus Agent mode. #19684
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental `integral()` function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the `--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions` flag. #14440
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental query cost estimation, actual cost reporting, and configurable execution limits, enabled with `--enable-feature=query-cost`. #20028
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Smoothed and Anchored vector selectors are now stable and always-on. #19697
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Use start timestamps to detect counter resets when float timeseries are queried using extended range selector modifiers (`anchored`, `smoothed`). This feature is hidden behind `use-start-timestamps` feature flag. #18966
- [FEATURE] Promtool: print test filename during promtool tests #18271
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Allow unquoted Unicode letters and dots behind a feature flag #20162
- [ENHANCEMENT] Search API: Warn when participating remote-read storage does not support search. #19992
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Read: Add native histogram prometheus_remote_read_handler_gate_wait_duration_seconds to measure concurrency-gate wait duration, including requests canceled while waiting. #18355
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Write: Add experimental flag `convert_nhcb_to_classic` to convert NHCB to classic histograms for external systems that dont support NHCBs. #17205
- [ENHANCEMENT] promtool: Add `--allow-incompatible-block-duration` so users can specify any max-block-duration instead of being restricted to the default Prometheus block durations. #19363
- [PERF] Remote write: Cache repeated OTLP histogram metric names. #19717
- [PERF] OpenMetrics 2.0 parser: Reuse classic histogram and summary expansion buffers across scrapes. #19907
- [PERF] PromQL: Decode only histogram sum/count (not buckets) for timestamp(), start_timestamp() and absent(). #19738
- [PERF] PromQL: Only select the fixed window for subqueries with an `@` modifier. #19863
- [PERF] Remote write / TSDB: Deduplicate per-series metadata structs in memory with `unique.Handle`. #20040
- [PERF] Scrape: Avoid some copies of scrape response bodies. #19394
- [PERF] TSDB: Improve XOR2 compression and append performance by selecting value windows based on encoding cost. #19962
- [PERF] TSDB: Reduce memory used writing and reading checkpoint metadata records. #19712
- [PERF] Scrape: Convert classic histograms to NHCB directly in the OpenMetrics 2.0 parser without wrapping in `NHCBParser`. #19880
- [PERF] Scrape: Reduce OpenMetrics 2.0 parser allocations and CPU overhead by lazily constructing composite series and exemplar labels. #19895
- [BUGFIX] Remote read: Abort failed streaming responses without writing duplicate headers or appending plain-text errors to the protobuf stream #19749
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix loss of out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record that the out-of-order write-behind log still needs #19737
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix queries that seek within a head chunk returning samples committed after the query started #19854
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve mapped chunks when WAL replay merges multiple references for the same series, preventing missing out-of-order samples and duplicate in-order chunks after restart #19805
- [BUGFIX] Fix auto-reload logic to reload after reverting a failed configuration change #19838
- [BUGFIX] API: Do not match metric family metadata for doubled _total and _info suffixes in experimental search API. #19910
- [BUGFIX] API: Reject `timeout` and `lookback_delta` values that overflow int64 instead of turning them into a negative duration #19658
- [BUGFIX] API: Resolve metric family metadata for suffixed metric names in search results, in experimental search API. #19824
- [BUGFIX] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache cluster once instead of twice for clusters that are not replication group members. #19434
- [BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands #19754
- [BUGFIX] Discovery: Fix a panic in Azure service discovery when a VM tag has a null value. #19755
- [BUGFIX] Federation: fix corruption of float native histograms. #19679
- [BUGFIX] Fix ts_of_last_over_time for samples before the Unix epoch. #19828
- [BUGFIX] Histograms: Fix ConvertNHCBToClassic inflating classic bucket counts for integer native histograms whose spans have gaps. #19659
- [BUGFIX] Logging: Preserve rule and TSDB block values in JSON logs. #19572
- [BUGFIX] OTLP receiver: Drop exemplars with timestamps more than 10 minutes in the future instead of storing them and blocking subsequent exemplars for that series. #19812
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Count only out-of-order exemplars in `prometheus_api_otlp_out_of_order_exemplars_total`, not every rejected exemplar. #20030
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not drop exemplars that have a `trace_id` or `span_id` filtered attribute in addition to a trace or span ID. The trace context now takes precedence over the colliding attribute, as required by the OpenTelemetry specification. #20004
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not emit `le="+Inf"` twice when a histogram's explicit bounds end at `+Inf`, and warn about the bound. #19425
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Stop dropping exemplars that arrive out of timestamp order within a data point. #20029
- [BUGFIX] OpenMetrics 2.0: Attach histogram exemplars to matching classic `_bucket` series and preserve them when scraping both native and classic histograms. #20020
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Avoid intermediate overflow in `rad()` and `deg()` conversions. #19901
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Consistently ignore and drop `__type__` and `__unit__` labels in `without` aggregations, `absent()`, `info()`, and binary operator fill matching. #19986
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Do not panic when printing the partial AST returned alongside a parse error. #19797
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Drop __type__ and __unit__ in binary operations so they are transparent to users, similar to how __name__ is handled. #18680
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix `==`, `!=`, `changes()` and `count_values` on native histograms giving wrong results inside `histogram_count()`, `histogram_sum()` and `histogram_avg()`. #20024
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_fraction returning wrong results for native histograms with custom buckets when a bucket boundary is exactly 0. #19657
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_quantile and histogram_quantiles interpolating within the wrong bucket for native histograms whose sum is NaN. #19973
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix lexing of subqueries whose range is a duration keyword expression, e.g. `foo[range():1s]`. #19729
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix warning and error locations for duration expressions `min_of` and `max_of`. #19742
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Ignore NaN classic histogram bucket boundaries in `histogram_quantile`, `histogram_quantiles` and `histogram_fraction` and return correct value instead of NaN if there are normal buckets. #20057
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve infinite values at exact quantile ranks. #19899
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve original operand sides for experimental fill modifiers with group_right matching. #19939
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve subquery step expressions when printing queries after preprocessing. #19743
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Range vector functions no longer raise a spurious "vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset" error when series have different metric names but the same remaining labels, as long as their timestamps do not overlap within the evaluated range window #18631
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: do not count subquery materialized samples in total samples statistics #19873
- [BUGFIX] Remote write: Prevent future-dated exemplars from scaling shards down to the minimum. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Agent: Prevent future sent timestamps from advancing WAL truncation beyond the minimum retention window. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Rules: Restore firing alerts with for durations shorter than --rules.alert.for-grace-period after a restart. #19882
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: fix failing scrape when float histogram is emitted over protobuf with count, zero count and buckets all zero, for example a result of recording `rate(x[1m])` over constant histogram. #19682
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Return the lexically smallest label values when `limit` is set on `/api/v1/search/label_values`, instead of an arbitrary subset #19694
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix WAL watcher permanently skipping checkpoint series garbage collection when lagging behind head truncation. #20041
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Avoid panics when the requested time range has no participating storage. #19992
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a race in selected-series and stale-series compaction where a sample committed after the block was written but before the series was evicted from the head could be silently lost. The fix no longer depends on isolation being enabled. #19666
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a rare case where a sample could be lost during selected-series or stale-series compaction if an unrelated write to the same series ran cleanup that erased the evidence needed to protect it. #19672
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix spurious "unknown series references" warnings during WAL replay after a restart, when the only blocks on disk were produced by selected-series or stale-series compaction. #19734
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Increment `prometheus_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total` when WAL corruption is detected during checkpoint creation, so the metric reflects corruption found at compaction time rather than only after a restart-triggered repair. #19858
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve series identities needed to recover exemplars after compaction and restart. #19940
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Reject native histograms whose span offsets overflow the int32 bucket index instead of storing them with corrupted buckets. #20034
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: fix no passing metadata-wal-records to TSDB from main feature flag. #19678
- [BUGFIX] Templates: Preserve IPv6 addresses with dotted zone identifiers in `stripDomain`. #19908
- [BUGFIX] UI: Don't automatically open an autocomplete dropdown after closing a function call body or aggregation operator with a closing parenthesis. #19825
- [BUGFIX] Web: Fix HTTP/2 negotiation silently falling back to HTTP/1.1 under Go 1.27+ when TLS is enabled with `http2: true`. The server now correctly advertises `h2` via ALPN and multiplexes concurrent requests over a single connection. #19848
- [BUGFIX] mixin: Fix double-counting of failed samples in the `PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures` alert denominator. #19877
- [BUGFIX] promtool: Honor `--enable-feature` when evaluating rules in `test rules`. #20046
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Ensure UTF-8 works with the experimental OpenMetrics 2.0 #19902
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Reject sum-only classic histograms during NHCB conversion #19315

[RELEASE] Released version 3.5-dev11

Released version 3.5-dev11 with the following main changes :
    - BUILD: sym: Fix build on recent glibc
    - BUG/MINOR: checks/log: force implicit UDP checks as TCP for log backend
    - CLEANUP: sym: factor out the short object name extraction

    - BUG/MINOR: debug: fix "debug dev fd" crash on unknown address families
    - BUILD: Makefile: allow external makefiles to provide build targets
    - BUG/MEDIUM: ssl: skip TLS 1.3 suites in the FIPS TLS 1.2 cipher check
    - REGTESTS: ssl: skip AWS-LC FIPS rejected crypto in ciphersuites/curves tests
    - CI: github: add AWS-LC FIPS testing workflow

    - BUG/MEDIUM: proxy: fix stick table expired entries cleanup on stopping
    - BUG/MINOR: http-ana: fix response compression for applets
    - DOC: configuration: Clarify wait-for-body doc for the response side
    - MINOR: http-act: Add 'no-fail' option on 'wait-for-body' action
    - BUG/MEDIUM: leastconn: reset the smallest key when backups take over
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove duplicated key phase pointer assignments
    - MINOR: quic: use the right trace event in quic_tls_key_update()
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove duplicated rx offset initialization in quic_cstream_new()
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove the unused tx part of struct quic_cstream
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove unused tx crypto size and offset counters
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: fix the header protection key length dump with AWS-LC
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove the unused key parameter from quic_tls_decrypt()
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove the unused count and flags from struct quic_tls_kp
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove the stale initial_salt declaration
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove duplicated quic_cstream_new() declaration
    - CLEANUP: quic: remove the unneeded quic_rx.h include from quic_tls.c
    - CLEANUP: quic: update the outdated comment of quic_tls_derive_keys()
    - BUG/MINOR: sample: realign the ungrpc converter on message boundaries
    - BUG/MEDIUM: compression: fix incompatibility between compression and large-buffers
    - CLEANUP: tools: make inetaddr_host_lim*() usable on untrusted inputs
    - BUG/MINOR: flt-http-comp: check the block returned by htx_replace_blk_value()
    - BUG/MINOR: compression: pass the configured level to slz
    - OPTIM: flt-http-comp: only flush the compressor after the last DATA block
    - IMPORT: slz: update slz to version 1.4-dev4
    - MINOR: compression: pass the content type to the algorithms' init function
    - MINOR: flt-http-comp: size the compression reserve using SLZ_MAX_OVERHEAD()
    - REGTESTS: compression: check hard to compress contents and nearly full buffers
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't drop pending output on a short content-length
    - BUG/MINOR: filters: Reject id-less implicit instances of multi-instance classes
    - BUG/MINOR: ssl/ckch: free the new instance when ckch_inst_rebuild() fails
    - BUG/MEDIUM: ssl/cli: reset the ongoing transaction when "commit ssl cert" is interrupted
    - BUG/MEDIUM: ssl/cli: don't unlock the certificate lock after a failed trylock
    - BUG/MINOR: httpclient/lua: fix stack overread when copying the headers
    - BUG/MINOR: httpclient/lua: raise an error on too many request headers
    - BUG/MINOR: resolvers: validate TXT RDATA before reading
    - MINOR: stream: add per-stream memory slots
    - BUG/MINOR: haterm: fix the response body phase on short writes
    - BUG/MEDIUM: haload: restore request accounting after user timeouts
    - BUG/MEDIUM: ssl: disable kTLS on OpenSSL versions affected by a known bug
    - DOC: config: add missing empty line before tune.ssl.ktls-unsafe
    - BUG/MINOR: ist: make ist_find_range() accept non-zero min boundaries
